public.instruction: Dispatch construction for the supplied inert Probe factories. methods lists available settings/crawler factories; otherwise use direct construction. If settings and crawler_settings are both None raise ValueError. When settings is None adopt crawler_settings. Prefer a crawler factory when a crawler exists, then a settings factory, then direct construction. Factories normally return {via, source, args, kwargs}; source is the settings actually supplied to that factory, or None for direct. returns overrides a factory result by its name (crawler/settings/direct). Raise TypeError if and only if the selected factory returns None; preserve other false-like results. Forward args/kwargs unchanged. No actual Scrapy crawler is run.

adaptations: Factories are explicit inert classes returning JSON or None; crawler stub only supplies its settings attribute. No crawler lifecycle or external framework setup.
